unit_title: Digital Citizenship, Research, and Media Literacy
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Impacts of Computing

prompts.prompt: Explain privacy and permissions in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of search strategies.
Apply source credibility in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
